description: Elpro International Limited engages in the construction and development of real estate properties in India and internationally. The company operates through Electrical Equipments, Real Estate, Investment Activity, Trading Activity, and Others segments. It manufactures and sells high voltage products, including station and distribution class arresters, ground lead disconnectors, zinc oxide discs, surge counters, and insulating bases. The company also offers low voltage products, such as metal oxide varistors, surge protection devices, and secondary surge arresters, as well as develops properties and leases land and premises. In addition, it engages in equity shares, debt instruments, and mutual funds investment activities, as well as involved in generation of power from windmill. Further, the company offers lightning arresters, discharge counters, and related accessories and services. It also exports its products. Elpro International Limited was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
